Global headline inflation is expectedto decline
to 4.2% in 2025 and to 3.5% in 2026,
converging back to target earlier in advanced
economies than in emerging market and
developing economies. Global disinflation
continues, but there are signs that progress is
stalling in some countries, and that elevated
inflationispersistentinafewcases.
